record.context_brief: Sixth moment of twists of Maass forms
record.original_question: Heath-Brown proved a Weyl-strength twelfth-moment bound for the Riemann zeta function, Jutila proved an analogous sixth-moment result in the t-aspect for L(1/2 + it, f) with f a Hecke-Maass cusp form, and complementary twelfth-moment results are known for Dirichlet L-functions in the level aspect. Prove the analogous Weyl-strength bound for the sixth moment of L(1/2, f tensor chi).

evidence.quote: Can one also prove analogous bounds for the sixth moment of L(1/2, f ⊗ χ)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $f$ be a fixed Hecke–Maass cusp form for $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$, with associated $L$-function $L(s,f)$. For a primitive Dirichlet character $\chi$ modulo $q$, let $L(s, f\otimes\chi)$ denote the twisted $L$-function, normalized so that its functional equation relates $s\leftrightarrow 1-s$ and so that the central point is $s=1/2$. The convexity bound in the level aspect is $L(1/2, f\otimes\chi)\ll_{f,\varepsilon} q^{1/2+\varepsilon}$, and the Weyl-strength bound is $L(1/2, f\otimes\chi)\ll_{f,\varepsilon} q^{1/3+\varepsilon}$.

Prove a Weyl-strength sixth moment bound in the level aspect for these twisted $L$-functions: namely, establish
$$\sum_{\chi \bmod q}^{\ast}\bigl|L(\tfrac12, f\otimes\chi)\bigr|^{6}\ \ll_{f,\varepsilon}\ q^{2+\varepsilon},$$
where $\sum^{\ast}$ denotes the sum over primitive Dirichlet characters modulo $q$, with $q\to\infty$ (one may assume $q$ prime if desired). Equivalently, prove the analogue, for the family $\{L(1/2, f\otimes\chi)\}_{\chi\bmod q}$, of Heath-Brown's twelfth-moment bound for the Riemann zeta function on the critical line and of Jutila's sixth-moment bound in the $t$-aspect for $L(1/2+it, f)$.
artifact.status_search_result: Web search indicates that while Weyl-strength subconvexity bounds for individual $L(1/2,f\otimes\chi)$ in the level aspect have been studied (e.g. via delta methods, and for Dirichlet $L$-functions the twelfth-moment Weyl bound by Petrow–Young in cube-free conductor), no proof of a Weyl-strength sixth moment bound for the family $\{L(1/2,f\otimes\chi)\}_{\chi\bmod q}$ appears in the literature. The problem is stated as an open question.

status_evidence.title: The Weyl bound for Dirichlet L-functions of cube-free conductor
status_evidence.snippet: Petrow–Young establish the Weyl bound (and underlying twelfth-moment) for Dirichlet L-functions in the level aspect, the GL(1) analogue of the desired sixth moment for GL(2) twists.
status_evidence.claim: The GL(1) twelfth-moment / Weyl bound in level aspect is known, but its GL(2) analogue (sixth moment of f⊗χ) is not stated as proved.

status_evidence.title: Weyl bound for GL(2) in t-aspect via a simple delta method
status_evidence.snippet: Provides Weyl bound for L(1/2+it, f) in the t-aspect via a delta method, paralleling Jutila's sixth-moment result, but does not address the sixth moment over twists by Dirichlet characters in the level aspect.
status_evidence.claim: Existing Weyl bounds for GL(2) handle the t-aspect; the level-aspect sixth moment over χ remains an open analogue.
